category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: речевые образцы знакомства: только I'm + имя (Hello, I'm Nanny Shine / Hello, I'm Anna), What's your name? — My name is …; формула How are you today? — Fine, thanks!
example: Hello, I'm Nanny Shine. What's your name? — Hello, I'm Anna.
comment: впервые; только утверждение с I и готовые фразы; правила и других лиц нет

scope: только this is + существительное в ед. ч. для представления людей и предметов: This is my sister Lulu. This is my friend … . This is my … (pen, book, pencil, workbook); только утверждение
example: I'm Larry! This is my sister Lulu.
comment: впервые; that/these/those нет; these are — в Unit 3 и Unit 10
source: SB p.18, SB p.20, SB p.21

scope: my (This is my sister), your (What's your name? open/close your books), his/her: What's his/her name? — His/her name is … .
example: What's his/her name? — His/her name is … .
comment: впервые; в образцах; our/their — в Unit 15
source: SB p.18, SB p.19, SB p.21, SB p.23

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: I'm + имя (I'm Larry; песня I'm Punch, I'm Judy); He/She is + имя (He/she is Punch/Judy); His/her name is … ; только утверждение
example: He/she is Punch/Judy.
comment: вопросов с to be и отрицаний нет
source: SB p.18, SB p.19, SB p.20

scope: утвердительный повелительный наклон. в песне и классных командах: Stand up, sit down, keep moving! Open your books. Close your books.; в диалоге Close your eyes! Open your eyes now!
example: Stand up, sit down, keep moving!
comment: впервые; только утвердительная форма; отрицательная (Don't …) не дана

scope: What colour is …? — It's + цвет (What colour is the snake? — It's green.); My favourite colour is (red).
example: What colour is the snake? — It's green.
comment: what уже в What's your name? (Let's Go); цвета даны лексикой

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: утверждение I've got a … / You've got a … / He's/she's got a …; вопрос только с you: Have you got a …?; краткие ответы Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
example: I've got a … . Have you got a …? — Yes, I have./No, I haven't.
comment: впервые; полных форм (have got/has got) нет; отрицательного утверждения нет; вопроса с he/she нет; we/they — в Unit 1

scope: What's this? — It's a + предмет (It's a radio!); What's this, Larry? — It's a radio, Grandpa!
example: What's this? — It's a radio!
comment: впервые как образец диалога

scope: только a перед существительным в ед. ч.: It's a radio, a red chair, a yellow table, a white bed
example: Oh, a red chair!
comment: an и правило выбора a/an здесь не даны — an появляется в Unit 5
source: SB p.26, SB p.27, SB p.28

scope: прилагательное-цвет перед существительным: a red chair, a yellow table, a white bed, a black chair, a green tree house, a brown table
example: Look, Grandma! A yellow table!
comment: правило не формулируется, только образцы; повторение в Now I Know М1
source: SB p.27, SB p.28, SB p.43

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: общий вопрос с it: Is it a chair?; краткие ответы Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.; It's a table.
example: Is it a chair? — Yes, it is./No, it isn't. It's a table.
comment: впервые вопрос и краткий ответ с to be; только it

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: расширение лиц: She's got a white bed. He's got a … . We've got a … . They've got a … .; I've got a blue chair (Portfolio), I've got a kitchen (Now I Know); только утверждение
example: She's got a white bed. We've got a … . They've got a … .
comment: добавились we/they; вопросы и отрицание не отрабатываются
source: SB p.28, SB p.29, SB p.38, SB p.42

scope: Where's + ед. ч.? / Where are + мн. ч.?: Where's Mummy? — She is in the kitchen. Where are Grandma and Grandpa? — They are … (in the garden). Where's Daddy? — He's in the bedroom.
example: Where's Mummy? — She is in the kitchen.
comment: впервые where
source: SB p.30, SB p.31, SB p.32, SB p.42

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: he/she is, they are при указании места: She is in the kitchen. He's in the bedroom. They are … . Mummy's in the kitchen. Chuckles is in the house.; только утверждение
example: He's in the bedroom.
comment: добавились he/she/they (полная и краткая форма he's/she's); вопрос — в Unit 3
source: SB p.30, SB p.31, SB p.32, SB p.33

scope: только in с комнатами: in the kitchen, in the bedroom, in the garden, in the house
example: Daddy is in the bedroom.
comment: впервые; on — в Unit 3 (песня), полный набор in/on/under/near — в Unit 10

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: общий вопрос с he/именем: Is Chuckles in the living room? Is he in the kitchen?; краткие ответы No, he isn't. / Yes, he is!
example: Is he in the bathroom? — Yes, he is!
comment: вопрос с he и краткие ответы he; с she/they не даны

scope: in и on в песне: Footprints in the kitchen/in the hall/in the bedroom, on the floor/on the wall/on the stairs/on the chairs; These are his footprints on the door.
example: Footprints on the floor, Footprints on the wall!
comment: проверить: on дан только в песне и одном образце, отдельно не вводится

scope: this is (This is my house. This is a …) и впервые these are + мн. ч.: These are his footprints on the door.
example: These are his footprints on the door.
comment: these — один образец; that/those нет

scope: one — twelve (1–12) в структуре возраста: How old are you? — I'm five!
example: How old are you? — I'm five!
comment: впервые; числа до 12

scope: How old are you? (How old are you today? How old is Lulu?) — I'm + число
example: How old are you? — I'm five!
comment: впервые how old
source: SB p.44, SB p.45, SB p.47

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: to be + прилагательное/число/существительное: I'm five. I'm happy today. You're happy today. He's happy/sad. It's a party. They are candles.; I'm from Russia. My name is … ; только утверждение
example: I'm happy, I'm happy today!
comment: добавились you're и they are + сущ.; отрицаний нет
source: SB p.45, SB p.46, SB p.47

scope: задание «Как образуется множественное число в английском языке?»: an apple — apples, a sandwich — sandwiches, a burger — burgers, a banana — bananas, an egg — eggs; окончание -s, после ch — -es (выделено цветом); выбор ед./мн. ч.: egg/eggs, apple/apples, chip/chips, sandwich/sandwiches (Now I Know)
example: an apple — apples, a sandwich — sandwiches
comment: впервые; правило выводится из образца, словесно не сформулировано; проверить: в том же ряду a fish — … (мн. ч. fish не показано)

scope: an перед гласной против a (выделено цветом): an apple, an egg — a sandwich, a burger, a banana, a fish; Have an apple!
example: an apple, an egg; a banana
comment: впервые an; правило не сформулировано, только образцы

scope: только глагол like: I like burgers. I don't like eggs. Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.; He/She likes … . He/She doesn't like … .
example: Do you like cheese? — Yes, I do. Yummy!/No, I don't. Yuk.
comment: впервые; лексически ограничено like; вопрос только с you; does-вопрос — в Unit 6; правило -s не дано

scope: вопрос с she и краткие ответы: Does she like …? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.; I like chips! I don't like bananas!; повторение I like … . He/She likes … . (Now I Know)
example: Does she like …? — Yes, she does. No, she doesn't.
comment: по-прежнему только like; далее в Unit 13 — loves (Larry loves …)
source: SB p.54, SB p.55, SB p.60

scope: What's your favourite food? — My favourite food is pizza.
example: What's your favourite food? — Pizza, yummy!
comment: образец введён в Unit 5 (p.48), закреплён в Unit 6 и Now I Know
source: SB p.48, SB p.53, SB p.60

scope: одно задание: Nanny's favourite food is … .
example: Nanny's favourite food is … .
comment: проверить: правило не дано, только образец; далее встречается в текстах (Timka's medals, Town Mouse's bedroom)

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: только просьба Can I have a/an …, please?
example: Can I have an ice cream, please?
comment: впервые; ответов не дано; расширение — Unit 14

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: утверждение can + глагол: I can jump like a frog. I can jump too. A frog can jump. Larry can dance.; лица I и 3-е лицо (существительное)
example: I can jump like a frog.
comment: впервые; вопрос и отрицание — в Unit 8
source: SB p.4, SB p.5, SB p.6, SB p.7

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: вопрос с you и краткие ответы: Can you jump? — Yes, I can. Can you fly? — No, I can't.; отрицание can't: Larry can/can't climb the tree.; с it: Can a horse run? — Yes, it can. Can a frog fly? — No, it can't.; It can jump and run. It can't fly. (Unit 10)
example: Can you jump? — Yes, I can. Can you fly? — No, I can't.
comment: полная форма cannot не дана; Portfolio: I can sing and I can dance
source: SB p.8, SB p.9, SB p.10, SB p.11, SB p.16, SB p.20, SB p.21, SB p.25

scope: только like + -ing: I like dancing / jumping / swimming / singing / running / climbing trees.
example: I like swimming.
comment: впервые; правило образования -ing не дано

scope: выбор his/her по полу: His/Her name is Chuckles/Cherry.
example: Her name is Cherry.
comment: повторение из Starter

scope: таблица: There is + ед. ч. (a clown, a rabbit, a magician) / There are + мн. ч. (dogs, horses) at the circus; в песне There's a very funny clown.
example: There is a clown at the circus. There are dogs at the circus.
comment: впервые; только утверждение; отрицание — в Unit 10, вопрос — в Unit 11

scope: in, on, under, near (вводятся как слова): Where's the teddy bear? — It's on the table. Where are the teddy bears? — They are under the shelf. Is it under the table? — No, it isn't.; выбор предлога: The toys are on/in the toy box. The ballerinas are near/on the beds.
example: Where are the teddy bears? — They are under the shelf.
comment: основной ввод предлогов места; повторение Now I Know М4 и Activities М4 (Under/On the table)
source: SB p.22, SB p.23, SB p.24, SB p.38, SB p.59

scope: Where's + ед. ч.? — It's …; Where are + мн. ч.? — They are …
example: Where's the teddy bear? — It's in the toy box.
comment: повторение where из Unit 2 с it/they

scope: отрицание (таблица): There isn't a … / There aren't … in the toy box (a cat, dogs, elephants …)
example: There aren't dogs in the toy box.
comment: краткие формы isn't/aren't; полных is not/are not нет; any в образце нет

scope: this is + ед. ч. / these are + мн. ч.: These are my dolls. This is my toy soldier. This is my teddy bear. This is my toy dog.
example: These are my dolls. This is my toy soldier.
comment: в песне и образце; that/those нет

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: I've got green/blue eyes; в песне отрицание I haven't got toes!; She's got blue eyes. He's got dark hair. My ballerina's got … eyes. My toy soldier's got … hair.; What have you got?
example: I've got green eyes! She's got blue eyes!
comment: отрицание I haven't got — только в песне; вопрос What have you got? — только в диалоге
source: SB p.26, SB p.27, SB p.28

scope: «Прочитай и запомни формы множественного числа»: foot — feet, mouse — mice, child — children, man — men
example: foot — feet, mouse — mice
comment: впервые; только 4 слова; mice встречается ещё в тексте (two small mice, Where are the mice?)

scope: вопрос и краткие ответы (таблица): Is there a teddy bear / a ball / a house? Are there toy soldiers / cars?; Yes, there is. / Yes, there are. No, there isn't. / No, there aren't.; повторение: There is a ball under the bed. There are toys in the toy box.
example: Is there a ball? — Yes, there is. Are there cars? — No, there aren't.
comment: полная схема +/?/краткие ответы к концу М4

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: 3-е лицо: He's got two big eyes. He's got a small black nose. It's got dark hair, a big nose … ; отрицание he: He hasn't got a nose! Teddy hasn't got any eyes!; ответ Yes, he has!; полная форма The Town Mouse has got … eyes. He has got a … nose. (Activities М4)
example: He hasn't got a nose! — Yes, he has! He's got a small black nose.
comment: отрицание hasn't got и Yes, he has — в диалоге; any только в «hasn't got any eyes» без правила; вопрос Has he got …? не дан
source: SB p.31, SB p.32, SB p.34, SB p.38, SB p.39, SB p.59

scope: размер и цвет перед существительным, два прилагательных подряд: big/small eyes, fair/dark hair, a big nose, small ears, a small black nose
example: He's got a small black nose.
comment: порядок прилагательных не объясняется
source: SB p.30, SB p.31, SB p.38

scope: How many + мн. ч. + are there …?: How many puppets are there on the wall? How many toy dogs are there in your toy box?
example: How many puppets are there on the wall?
comment: впервые how many; ответ не задан образцом

scope: Let's go to the … . We can … there. (Let's go to the cinema. We can see a film there.)
example: Let's go to the cinema.
comment: раздел Fun at school (Where I Live and What I Do), урок не указан; как речевой образец — здесь; раньше Let's go! только в песнях и диалогах (с p.4)

scope: Put on your hat/coat! Take off your jacket! (образец диалога и песня)
example: It's hot! Take off your jacket!
comment: Don't be sad / Don't worry — только в диалогах, отрицательная форма не отрабатывается

scope: It's + прилагательное о погоде: It's sunny! It's hot! It's raining! (Unit 13); It's windy! It's cold! (Unit 14)
example: It's hot today!
comment: It's raining — как готовая фраза, без связи с Present Continuous
source: SB p.40, SB p.44, SB p.56

scope: только глагол wear, только утверждение: I'm wearing my hat. He's wearing his blue jacket! She's wearing her red coat!; значение — сейчас (что надето)
example: Look! He's wearing his blue … !
comment: впервые; вопросов и отрицаний нет; правило -ing не дано
source: SB p.41, SB p.42, SB p.43

scope: What's the weather like? — It's + прилагательное (cold, hot …)
example: What's the weather like? — It's cold!

scope: выбор a/an: Look! a A garden! b An island!; It's an island!
example: It's an island!
comment: повторение из Unit 5

category: Глаголы: to be / have got / модальные
scope: вопрос-просьба Can I/we + глагол?: Can I wear my jeans? Can I play at home? Can I take off my jacket? Can we go in the boat?
example: It's hot today. — Can I take off my jacket?
comment: ответы-разрешения не даны образцом (в диалоге Of course!); классные фразы Can I come in? Can I go out? — In the Classroom (p.75)
source: SB p.41, SB p.47, SB p.75

scope: we — our, they — their: We're on our summer holiday. They're on their summer holiday.; вставить: They're in … house. We're in … room. We play with … toys.
example: We're on our summer holiday. They're on their summer holiday.
comment: впервые our/their; полной таблицы нет (its нет)

scope: Larry and Lulu о себе — we, Nanny о них — they: We're … / They're …
example: We're on our summer holiday. They're on their summer holiday.
comment: I/you/he/she/it уже использовались с Starter без таблицы

scope: he/she + wearing в игре и Now I Know: He's wearing a yellow T-shirt! The Kangaroo King is wearing a jacket and socks.; выбор I'm/He's/She's + wearing my/his/her …; в песне we-формы: We're having lots of fun! We're playing in the sun! We're sailing away.
example: He's wearing a yellow T-shirt!
comment: отрабатывается только wear; we're having/playing/sailing — только в песнях; вопросов и отрицаний нет; повторение в Showtime (Chuckles is wearing my teddy bear costume)
source: SB p.47, SB p.48, SB p.50, SB p.52, SB p.57, SB p.65

scope: в песнях: Eat your eggs! Drink your juice! Put on your hat! Get your costume! Turn around! Touch the ground! Climb the stairs! Turn off the lights! Say goodnight!; Please, don't forget …; Sit here and be good!
example: Teddy bear, teddy bear, turn around!
comment: повторение; don't — только в песне
source: SB p.64, SB p.66, SB p.67
